definitions.explanation: To go back to an earlier point in audio or video content.

examples.japanese: {巻|ま}き{戻|もど}しボタンを{押|お}す。
{聞|き}き{逃|のが}したので{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: I missed it so I rewound.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}な{場面|ばめん}を{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}して、もう{一度|いちど}{見|み}た。
examples.english: I rewound to the important scene and watched it again.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}を{言|い}ったか{分|わ}からなかったので、{少|すこ}し{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}して{字幕|じまく}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I didn't understand what was said, so I rewound a bit and checked the subtitles.

notes:
{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}し comes from the era of tape media where you literally "wound back" the tape.

ETYMOLOGY:
{巻|ま}く (to wind) + {戻|もど}す (to return) = rewind

MEDIA CONTROL TERMS:
- {再生|さいせい}: play
- {一時停止|いちじていし}: pause
- {早送|はやおく}り: fast forward
- {巻|ま}き{戻|もど}し: rewind
